id-00001.name: Amphibious
id-00001.desc: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

id-00002.name: Eldritch Restoration
id-00002.desc: If destroyed, the aboleth gains a new body in 5d10 days, reviving with all its Hit Points in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the GM.

id-00003.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
id-00003.desc: If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

id-00004.name: Mucus Cloud
id-00004.desc: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by mucus. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the aboleth at the end of the aboleth's turn. Failure: The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target's skin becomes slimy, the target can breathe air and water, and it can't regain Hit Points unless it is underwater. While the cursed creature is outside a body of water, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Acid damage at the end of every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to its skin before those minutes have passed.

id-00005.name: Probing Telepathy
id-00005.desc: If a creature the aboleth can see communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The aboleth makes two Tentacle attacks and uses either Consume Memories or Dominate Mind if available.

id-00002.name: Tentacle
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of four tentacles.

id-00003.name: Consume Memories
id-00003.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 30 feet that is Charmed or Grappled by the aboleth. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The aboleth gains the target's memories if the target is a Humanoid and is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this action.

id-00004.name: Dominate Mind (2/Day)
id-00004.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the aboleth can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the aboleth dies or is on a different plane of existence from the target. While Charmed, the target acts as an ally to the aboleth and is under its control while within 60 feet of it. In addition, the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance. The target repeats the save whenever it takes damage as well as after every 24 hours it spends at least 1 mile away from the aboleth, ending the effect on itself on a success.

id-00001.name: Legendary Action Uses
id-00001.desc: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the aboleth can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The aboleth regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

id-00002.name: Lash
id-00002.desc: The aboleth makes one Tentacle attack.

id-00003.name: Psychic Drain
id-00003.desc: If the aboleth has at least one creature Charmed or Grappled, it uses Consume Memories and regains 5 (1d10) Hit Points.

chuul.name: Chuul
chuul.languages: Understands Deep Speech but can't speak

id-00001.name: Amphibious
id-00001.desc: The chuul can breathe air and water.

id-00002.name: Sense Magic
id-00002.desc: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of itself. This trait otherwise works like the Detect Magic spell but isn't itself magical.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The chuul makes two Pincer attacks and uses Paralyzing Tentacles.

id-00002.name: Pincer
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two pincers.

id-00003.name: Paralyzing Tentacles
id-00003.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature Grappled by the chuul. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

id-00001.name: Light Sensitivity
id-00001.desc: While in Bright Light, the cloaker has Disadvantage on attack rolls.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The cloaker makes one Attach attack and two Tail attacks.

id-00002.name: Attach
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the cloaker attaches to it. While the cloaker is attached, the target has the Blinded condition, and the cloaker can't make Attach attacks against other targets. In addition, the cloaker halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage. The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to try to detach the cloaker, doing so by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check.

id-00003.name: Tail
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

id-00001.name: Moan
id-00001.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the cloaker. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the cloaker's next turn. Success: The target is immune to this cloaker's Moan for the next 24 hours.

id-00002.name: Phantasms (Recharge after a Short or Long Rest)
id-00002.desc: The cloaker casts the Mirror Image spell, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability. The spell ends early if the cloaker starts or ends its turn in Bright Light.

id-00001.name: Crush
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the darkmantle attaches to the target. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the darkmantle had Advantage on the attack roll, it covers the target, which has the Blinded condition and is suffocating while the darkmantle is attached in this way. While attached to a target, the darkmantle can attack only the target but has Advantage on its attack rolls. Its Speed becomes 0, it can't benefit from any bonus to its Speed, and it moves with the target. A creature can take an action to try to detach the darkmantle from itself, doing so with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement.

id-00002.name: Darkness Aura (1/Day)
id-00002.desc: Magical Darkness fills a 15-foot Emanation originating from the darkmantle. This effect lasts while the darkmantle maintains Concentration on it, up to 10 minutes. Darkvision can't penetrate this area, and no light can illuminate it.

id-00001.name: Aberrant Ground
id-00001.desc: The ground in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the mouther is Difficult Terrain.

id-00002.name: Gibbering
id-00002.desc: The mouther babbles incoherently while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, any creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the mouther while it is babbling. Failure: The target rolls 1d8 to determine what it does during the current turn: 1–4. The target does nothing. 5–6. The target takes no action or Bonus Action and uses all its movement to move in a random direction. 7–8. The target makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.

id-00001.name: Bite
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. The target dies if it is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack. Its body is then absorbed into the mouther, leaving only equipment behind.

id-00002.name: Blinding Spittle (Recharge 5–6)
id-00002.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 30 feet. Failure: 7 (2d6) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of the mouther's next turn.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The grick makes one Beak attack and one Tentacles attack.

id-00002.name: Beak
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

id-00003.name: Tentacles
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12) from all four tentacles.

id-00001.name: Bone Cudgel
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Psychic damage.

otyugh.name: Otyugh
otyugh.languages: Otyugh; telepathy 120 ft. (doesn't allow the receiving creature to respond telepathically)

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The otyugh makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.

id-00002.name: Bite
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition. Whenever the Poisoned target finishes a Long Rest, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10) and doesn't return to normal until the Poisoned condition ends on the target. Success: The Poisoned condition ends.

id-00003.name: Tentacle
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two tentacles.

id-00004.name: Tentacle Slam
id-00004.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature Grappled by the otyugh. Failure: 16 (3d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the otyugh's next turn. Suc- cess: Half damage only.

id-00001.name: Spider Climb
id-00001.desc: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The roper makes two Tentacle attacks, uses Reel, and makes two Bite attacks.

id-00002.name: Bite
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

id-00003.name: Tentacle
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 60 ft. Hit: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of six tentacles, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the grapple ends. The tentacle can be damaged, freeing a creature it has Grappled when destroyed (AC 20, HP 10, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage). Damaging the tentacle deals no damage to the roper, and a destroyed tentacle regrows at the start of the roper's next turn.

id-00004.name: Reel
id-00004.desc: The roper pulls each creature Grappled by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.

airelemental.name: Air Elemental
airelemental.conditionimmunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

id-00001.name: Air Form
id-00001.desc: The elemental can enter a creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The elemental makes two Thunderous Slam attacks.

id-00002.name: Thunderous Slam
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Thunder damage.

id-00003.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 4–6)
id-00003.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 13, one Medium or smaller creature in the elemental's space. Failure: 24 (4d10 + 2) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet straight away from the elemental and has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

id-00001.name: Fire Aura
id-00001.desc: At the end of each of the azer's turns, each creature of the azer's choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the azer takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage unless the azer has the Incapacitated condition.

id-00002.name: Illumination
id-00002.desc: The azer sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

id-00001.name: Burning Hammer
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

id-00001.name: Elemental Restoration
id-00001.desc: If the djinni dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into mist, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Air.

id-00002.name: Magic Resistance
id-00002.desc: The djinni has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

id-00003.name: Wishes
id-00003.desc: The djinni has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the djinni knows it, the djinni can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the djinni can understand. If the djinni casts the spell for the creature, the djinni suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the djinni has cast it three times, the djinni can't do so again for 365 days.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The djinni makes three attacks, using Storm Blade or Storm Bolt in any combination.

id-00002.name: Storm Blade
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 feet. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage.

id-00003.name: Storm Bolt
id-00003.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 feet. Hit: 13 (3d8) Thunder damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

id-00004.name: Create Whirlwind
id-00004.desc: The djinni conjures a whirlwind at a point it can see within 120 feet. The whirlwind fills a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high Cylinder centered on that point. The whirlwind lasts until the djinni's Concentration on it ends. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet at the start of each of its turns. Whenever the whirlwind enters a creature's space or a creature enters the whirlwind, that creature is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 17 (a creature makes this save only once per turn, and the djinni is unaffected). Failure: While in the whirlwind, the target has the Restrained condition and moves with the whirlwind. At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained target takes 21 (6d6) Thunder damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

id-00005.name: Spellcasting
id-00005.desc: The djinni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17): At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic 2/Day Each: Create Food and Water (can create wine instead of water), Tongues, Wind Walk 1/Day Each: Creation, Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift

earthelemental.name: Earth Elemental
earthelemental.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft.; Passive Perception 10

id-00001.name: Earth Glide
id-00001.desc: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

id-00002.name: Siege Monster
id-00002.desc: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The elemental makes two attacks, using Slam or Rock Launch in any combination.

id-00002.name: Slam
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

id-00003.name: Rock Launch
id-00003.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 60 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

id-00001.name: Elemental Restoration
id-00001.desc: If the efreeti dies outside the Elemental Plane of Fire, its body dissolves into ash, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Fire.

id-00002.name: Magic Resistance
id-00002.desc: The efreeti has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

id-00003.name: Wishes
id-00003.desc: The efreeti has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the efreeti knows it, the efreeti can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the efreeti can understand. If the efreeti casts the spell for the creature, the efreeti suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the efreeti has cast it three times, the efreeti can't do so again for 365 days.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The efreeti makes three attacks, using Heated Blade or Hurl Flame in any combination.

id-00002.name: Heated Blade
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 13 (2d12) Fire damage.

id-00003.name: Hurl Flame
id-00003.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 120 ft. Hit: 24 (7d6) Fire damage.

id-00004.name: Spellcasting
id-00004.desc: The efreeti casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16): At Will: Detect Magic, Elementalism 1/Day Each: Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift, Tongues, Wall of Fire (level 7 version)

fireelemental.name: Fire Elemental
fireelemental.conditionimmunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

id-00001.name: Fire Aura
id-00001.desc: At the end of each of the elemental's turns, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the elemental takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage. Creatures and flammable objects in the Emanation start burning.

id-00002.name: Fire Form
id-00002.desc: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

id-00003.name: Illumination
id-00003.desc: The elemental sheds Bright Light in a 30foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

id-00004.name: Water Susceptibility
id-00004.desc: The elemental takes 3 (1d6) Cold damage for every 5 feet the elemental moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The elemental makes two Burn attacks.

id-00002.name: Burn
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it starts burning.

id-00001.name: Flyby
id-00001.desc: The gargoyle doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The gargoyle makes two Claw attacks.

id-00002.name: Claw
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

invisiblestalker.name: Invisible Stalker
invisiblestalker.conditionimmunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

id-00001.name: Air Form
id-00001.desc: The stalker can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

id-00002.name: Invisibility
id-00002.desc: The stalker has the Invisible condition.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The stalker makes three Wind Swipe attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Vortex.

id-00002.name: Wind Swipe
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Force damage.

id-00003.name: Vortex
id-00003.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, one Large or smaller creature in the stalker's space. Failure: 7 (1d8 + 3) Thunder damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, the target can't cast spells with a Verbal component and takes 7 (2d6) Thunder damage at the start of each of the stalker's turns.

id-00001.name: Death Burst
id-00001.desc: The magmin explodes when it dies. Dex- terity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the magmin. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

id-00001.name: Touch
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.

id-00001.name: Ignited Illumination
id-00001.desc: The magmin sets itself ablaze or extinguishes its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

id-00001.name: Death Burst
id-00001.desc: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dex- terity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

id-00001.name: Claw
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

id-00002.name: Blinding Breath (Recharge 6)
id-00002.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of the mephit's next turn.

id-00003.name: Sleep (1/Day)
id-00003.desc: The mephit casts the Sleep spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 10).

id-00001.name: Death Burst
id-00001.desc: The mephit explodes when it dies. Consti- tution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

id-00001.name: Claw
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.

id-00002.name: Fog Cloud (1/Day)
id-00002.desc: The mephit casts Fog Cloud, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

id-00003.name: Frost Breath (Recharge 6)
id-00003.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (3d4) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

id-00001.name: Death Burst
id-00001.desc: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dex- terity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

id-00001.name: Claw
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

id-00002.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 6)
id-00002.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

id-00001.name: Blurred Form
id-00001.desc: Attack rolls against the mephit are made with Disadvantage unless the mephit has the Incapacitated condition.

id-00002.name: Death Burst
id-00002.desc: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dex- terity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

id-00001.name: Claw
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Fire damage.

id-00002.name: Steam Breath (Recharge 6)
id-00002.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage, and the target's Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of the mephit's next turn. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Being underwater doesn't grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

id-00001.name: Amphibious
id-00001.desc: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

id-00001.name: Ocean Spear
id-00001.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 3 (1d6) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, its Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the merfolk's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

id-00001.name: Fire Aura
id-00001.desc: At the end of each of the salamander's turns, each creature of the salamander's choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the salamander takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The salamander makes two Flame Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Constrict.

id-00002.name: Flame Spear
id-00002.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the salamander's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

id-00003.name: Constrict
id-00003.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Large or smaller creature the salamander can see within 10 feet. Failure: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

waterelemental.name: Water Elemental
waterelemental.conditionimmunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

id-00001.name: Freeze
id-00001.desc: If the elemental takes Cold damage, its Speed decreases by 20 feet until the end of its next turn.

id-00002.name: Water Form
id-00002.desc: The elemental can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The elemental makes two Slam attacks.

id-00002.name: Slam
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

id-00003.name: Whelm (Recharge 4–6)
id-00003.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in the elemental's space. Failure: 22 (4d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition, is suffocating unless it can breathe water, and takes 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the elemental's turns. The elemental can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at a time with Whelm. As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the elemental can pull a creature out of it by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check. Success: Half damage only.

xorn.name: Xorn
xorn.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft.; Passive Perception 16

id-00001.name: Earth Glide
id-00001.desc: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the xorn doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

id-00002.name: Treasure Sense
id-00002.desc: The xorn can pinpoint the location of precious metals and stones within 60 feet of itself.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The xorn makes one Bite attack and three Claw attacks.

id-00002.name: Bite
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

id-00003.name: Claw
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

id-00001.name: Charge
id-00001.desc: The xorn moves up to its Speed or Burrow Speed straight toward an enemy it can sense.

animatedarmor.name: Animated Armor
animatedarmor.conditionimmunities: Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The armor makes two Slam attacks.

id-00002.name: Slam
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

animatedflyingsword.name: Animated Flying Sword
animatedflyingsword.conditionimmunities: Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

id-00001.name: Slash
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage.

animatedrugofsmothering.name: Animated Rug of Smothering
animatedrugofsmothering.conditionimmunities: Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

id-00001.name: Smother
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the rug can give it the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) instead of dealing damage. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and takes 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The rug can smother only one creature at a time. While grappling the target, the rug can't take this action, the rug halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage.

claygolem.name: Clay Golem
claygolem.conditionimmunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

id-00001.name: Acid Absorption
id-00001.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to Acid damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Acid damage dealt.

id-00002.name: Berserk
id-00002.desc: Whenever the golem starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to be berserk until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied.

id-00003.name: Immutable Form
id-00003.desc: The golem can't shape-shift.

id-00004.name: Magic Resistance
id-00004.desc: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The golem makes two Slam attacks, or it makes three Slam attacks if it used Hasten this turn.

id-00002.name: Slam
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) Acid damage, and the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Acid damage taken.

id-00001.name: Hasten (Recharge 5–6)
id-00001.desc: The golem takes the Dash and Disengage actions.

fleshgolem.name: Flesh Golem
fleshgolem.conditionimmunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
fleshgolem.languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

id-00001.name: Aversion to Fire
id-00001.desc: If the golem takes Fire damage, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

id-00002.name: Berserk
id-00002.desc: Whenever the golem starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it remains so until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied. The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by taking an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check; the golem must be able to hear its creator. If this check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk until the start of its next turn, at which point it resumes rolling for the Berserk trait again if it is still Bloodied.

id-00003.name: Immutable Form
id-00003.desc: The golem can't shape-shift.

id-00004.name: Lightning Absorption
id-00004.desc: . Whenever the golem is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

id-00005.name: Magic Resistance
id-00005.desc: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The golem makes two Slam attacks.

id-00002.name: Slam
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Lightning damage.

id-00001.name: Gore
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the gorgon moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.

id-00002.name: Petrifying Breath (Recharge 5–6)
id-00002.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

id-00001.name: Trample
id-00001.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. Failure: 16 (2d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

homunculus.name: Homunculus
homunculus.languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

id-00001.name: Telepathic Bond
id-00001.desc: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, the two of them can communicate telepathically with each other.

id-00001.name: Bite
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the homunculus's next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. While Poisoned, the target has the Unconscious condition, which ends early if the target takes any damage.

irongolem.name: Iron Golem
irongolem.conditionimmunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
irongolem.languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

id-00001.name: Fire Absorption
id-00001.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to Fire damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Fire damage dealt.

id-00002.name: Immutable Form
id-00002.desc: The golem can't shape-shift.

id-00003.name: Magic Resistance
id-00003.desc: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The golem makes two attacks, using Bladed Arm or Fiery Bolt in any combination.

id-00002.name: Bladed Arm
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

id-00003.name: Fiery Bolt
id-00003.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. Hit: 36 (8d8) Fire damage.

id-00004.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 6)
id-00004.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Fail- ure: 55 (10d10) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.

shieldguardian.name: Shield Guardian
shieldguardian.conditionimmunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
shieldguardian.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 10
shieldguardian.languages: Understands commands given in any language but can't speak

id-00001.name: Bound
id-00001.desc: The guardian is magically bound to an amulet. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian.

id-00002.name: Regeneration
id-00002.desc: The guardian regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

id-00003.name: Spell Storing
id-00003.desc: A spellcaster who wears the guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster's spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The guardian makes two Fist attacks.

id-00002.name: Fist
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Force damage.

id-00001.name: Protection
id-00001.desc: Trigger: An attack roll hits the wearer of the guardian's amulet while the wearer is within 5 feet of the guardian. Response: The wearer gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack and possibly causing it to miss, until the start of the guardian's next turn.

stonegolem.name: Stone Golem
stonegolem.conditionimmunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
stonegolem.languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

id-00001.name: Immutable Form
id-00001.desc: The golem can't shape-shift.

id-00002.name: Magic Resistance
id-00002.desc: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The golem makes two attacks, using Slam or Force Bolt in any combination.

id-00002.name: Slam
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Force damage.

id-00003.name: Force Bolt
id-00003.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) Force damage.

id-00001.name: Slow (Recharge 5–6)
id-00001.desc: The golem casts the Slow spell, requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).

ankheg.name: Ankheg
ankheg.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft.; Passive Perception 11

id-00001.name: Tunneler
id-00001.desc: The ankheg can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

id-00001.name: Bite
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the ankheg), reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

id-00002.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 6)
id-00002.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Failure: 14 (4d6) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.

id-00001.name: Beak
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage.

id-00001.name: Bite
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

id-00001.name: Petrifying Gaze (Recharge 4–6)
id-00001.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. If the basilisk sees its reflection in the Cone, the basilisk must make this save. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The behir makes one Bite attack and uses Constrict.

id-00002.name: Bite
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Lightning damage.

id-00003.name: Constrict
id-00003.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 18, one Large or smaller creature the behir can see within 5 feet. Failure: 28 (5d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

id-00004.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6)
id-00004.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 90-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 66 (12d10) Lightning damage. Suc- cess: Half damage.

id-00001.name: Swallow
id-00001.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the behir (the behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time). Failure: The behir swallows the target, which is no longer Grappled. While swallowed, a creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and takes 21 (6d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns. If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the behir and has the Prone condition. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

bulette.name: Bulette
bulette.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 120 ft.; Passive Perception 16

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The bulette makes two Bite attacks.

id-00002.name: Bite
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage.

id-00003.name: Deadly Leap
id-00003.desc: The bulette spends 5 feet of movement to jump to a space within 15 feet that contains one or more Large or smaller creatures. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in the bulette's destination space. Failure: 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage, and the target is pushed 5 feet straight away from the bulette.

id-00001.name: Leap
id-00001.desc: The bulette jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The chimera makes one Ram attack, one Bite attack, and one Claw attack. It can replace the Claw attack with a use of Fire Breath if available.

id-00002.name: Bite
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, or 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage if the chimera had Advantage on the attack roll.

id-00003.name: Claw
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

id-00004.name: Ram
id-00004.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

id-00005.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
id-00005.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 31 (7d8) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

id-00001.name: Petrifying Bite
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition. The target repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition, instead of the Restrained condition, for 24 hours.

deathdog.name: Death Dog
deathdog.conditionimmunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, Unconscious

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The death dog makes two Bite attacks.

id-00002.name: Bite
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. First Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, the target's Hit Point maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and it repeats the save every 24 hours that elapse, ending the effect on itself on a success. Subsequent Failures: The Poisoned target's Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10).

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The doppelganger makes two Slam attacks and uses Unsettling Visage if available.

id-00002.name: Slam
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6 (with Advantage during the first round of each combat), reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

id-00003.name: Read Thoughts
id-00003.desc: The doppelganger casts Detect Thoughts, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).

id-00004.name: Unsettling Visage (Recharge 6)
id-00004.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the doppelganger that can see the doppelganger. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

id-00001.name: Shape-Shift
id-00001.desc: The doppelganger shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

id-00001.name: Spider Climb
id-00001.desc: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

id-00002.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
id-00002.desc: While in sunlight, the drider has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

id-00003.name: Web Walker
id-00003.desc: The drider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the drider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The drider makes three attacks, using Foreleg or Poison Burst in any combination.

id-00002.name: Foreleg
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

id-00003.name: Poison Burst
id-00003.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 120 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Poison damage.

id-00001.name: Magic of the Spider Queen (Recharge 5–6)
id-00001.desc: The drider casts Darkness, Faerie Fire, or Web, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14).

id-00001.name: Spider Climb
id-00001.desc: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

id-00002.name: Web Walker
id-00002.desc: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The ettercap makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

id-00002.name: Bite
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the ettercap's next turn.

id-00003.name: Claw
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

id-00004.name: Web Strand (Recharge 5–6)
id-00004.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, one Large or smaller creature the ettercap can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage).

id-00001.name: Reel
id-00001.desc: The ettercap pulls one creature within 30 feet of itself that is Restrained by its Web Strand up to 25 feet straight toward itself.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The griffon makes two Rend attacks.

id-00002.name: Rend
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from both of the griffon's front claws.

id-00001.name: Claw
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Slashing damage.

id-00002.name: Luring Song
id-00002.desc: The harpy sings a magical melody, which lasts until the harpy's Concentration ends on it. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, each Humanoid and Giant in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the harpy when the song starts. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the song ends and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. While Charmed, the target has the Incapacitated condition and ignores the Luring Song of other harpies. If the target is more than 5 feet from the harpy, the target moves on its turn toward the harpy by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the harpy. It doesn't avoid Opportunity Attacks; however, before moving into damaging terrain (such as lava or a pit) and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the harpy, the target repeats the save. Success: The target is immune to this harpy's Luring Song for 24 hours.

id-00001.name: Flyby
id-00001.desc: The hippogriff doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The hippogriff makes two Rend attacks.

id-00002.name: Rend
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

hydra.name: Hydra
hydra.conditionimmunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, Unconscious

id-00001.name: Hold Breath
id-00001.desc: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

id-00002.name: Multiple Heads
id-00002.desc: The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 25 damage or more on a single turn, one of its heads dies. The hydra dies if all its heads are dead. At the end of each of its turns when it has at least one living head, the hydra grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken Fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 20 Hit Points when it grows new heads.

id-00003.name: Reactive Heads
id-00003.desc: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra Reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attacks.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The hydra makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.

id-00002.name: Bite
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Piercing damage.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.languages: Understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, and Primordial but can't speak; telepathy 120 ft.

id-00001.name: Amphibious
id-00001.desc: The kraken can breathe air and water.

id-00002.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
id-00002.desc: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

id-00003.name: Siege Monster
id-00003.desc: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The kraken makes two Tentacle attacks and uses Fling, Lightning Strike, or Swallow.

id-00002.name: Tentacle
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 30 ft. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20) from one of ten tentacles, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

id-00003.name: Fling
id-00003.desc: The kraken throws a Large or smaller creature Grappled by it to a space it can see within 60 feet of itself that isn't in the air. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. Failure: 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

id-00004.name: Lightning Strike
id-00004.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23, one creature the kraken can see within 120 feet. Failure: 33 (6d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

id-00005.name: Swallow
id-00005.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature Grappled by the kraken (it can have up to four creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: 23 (3d8 + 10) Piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is swallowed and no longer Grappled. A swallowed creature has the Restrained condition, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and takes 24 (7d6) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns. If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the kraken with the Prone condition. If the kraken dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

id-00001.name: Legendary Action Uses
id-00001.desc: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the kraken can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The kraken regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

id-00002.name: Storm Bolt
id-00002.desc: The kraken uses Lightning Strike.

id-00003.name: Toxic Ink
id-00003.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the kraken while it is underwater. Failure: The target has the Blinded and Poisoned conditions until the end of the kraken's next turn. The kraken then moves up to its Speed. Failure or Success: The kraken can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The manticore makes three attacks, using Rend or Tail Spike in any combination.

id-00002.name: Rend
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

id-00003.name: Tail Spike
id-00003.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 100/200 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The medusa makes two Claw attacks and one Snake Hair attack, or it makes three Poison Ray attacks.

id-00002.name: Claw
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

id-00003.name: Snake Hair
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

id-00004.name: Poison Ray
id-00004.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 150 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Poison damage.

id-00001.name: Petrifying Gaze (Recharge 5–6)
id-00001.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. If the medusa sees its reflection in the Cone, the medusa must make this save. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

id-00001.name: Amphibious
id-00001.desc: The merrow can breathe air and water.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The merrow makes two attacks, using Bite, Claw, or Harpoon in any combination.

id-00002.name: Bite
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the merrow's next turn.

id-00003.name: Claw
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.

id-00004.name: Harpoon
id-00004.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the merrow pulls the target up to 15 feet straight toward itself.

id-00001.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
id-00001.desc: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

id-00001.name: Bite
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the mimic), reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage—or 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage if the target is Grappled by the mimic—plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.

id-00002.name: Pseudopod
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

id-00001.name: Shape-Shift
id-00001.desc: The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

id-00001.name: Abyssal Glaive
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

id-00002.name: Gore (Recharge 5–6)
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the minotaur moved 10+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The owlbear makes two Rend attacks.

id-00002.name: Rend
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage.

id-00001.name: Ethereal Sight
id-00001.desc: The spider can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane while on the Material Plane and vice versa.

id-00002.name: Spider Climb
id-00002.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

id-00003.name: Web Walker
id-00003.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The spider makes two Bite attacks.

id-00002.name: Bite
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target becomes Stable, and it has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. While Poisoned, the target also has the Paralyzed condition.

id-00001.name: Ethereal Jaunt
id-00001.desc: The spider teleports from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice versa.

purpleworm.name: Purple Worm
purpleworm.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft.; Passive Perception 9

id-00001.name: Tunneler
id-00001.desc: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The worm makes one Bite attack and one Tail Stinger attack.

id-00002.name: Bite
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

id-00003.name: Tail Stinger
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d6 + 9) Piercing damage plus 35 (10d6) Poison damage.

id-00001.name: Swallow
id-00001.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the worm (it can have up to three creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed by the worm, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and takes 17 (5d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns. If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the worm and has the Prone condition. If the worm dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

remorhaz.name: Remorhaz
remorhaz.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft.; Passive Perception 10

id-00001.name: Heat Aura
id-00001.desc: At the end of each of the remorhaz's turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the remorhaz takes 16 (3d10) Fire damage.

id-00001.name: Bite
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

id-00001.name: Swallow
id-00001.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the remorhaz (it can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed by the remorhaz, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the remorhaz, and it takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage at the start of each of the remorhaz's turns. If the remorhaz takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the remorhaz must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the remorhaz and has the Prone condition. If the remorhaz dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The roc makes two Beak attacks. It can replace one attack with a Talons attack.

id-00002.name: Beak
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 10 ft. Hit: 28 (3d12 + 9) Piercing damage.

id-00003.name: Talons
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 5 ft. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) Slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19) from both talons, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

id-00001.name: Swoop (Recharge 5–6)
id-00001.desc: If the roc has a creature Grappled, the roc flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and drops that creature.

id-00001.name: Iron Scent
id-00001.desc: The rust monster can pinpoint the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of itself.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The rust monster makes one Bite attack and uses Antennae twice.

id-00002.name: Bite
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

id-00003.name: Antennae
id-00003.desc: The rust monster targets one nonmagical metal object—armor or a weapon—worn or carried by a creature within 5 feet of itself. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, the creature with the object. Failure: The object takes a -1 penalty to the AC it offers (armor) or to its attack rolls (weapon). Armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10, and a weapon is destroyed if its penalty reaches -5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor or weapon.

id-00004.name: Destroy Metal
id-00004.desc: The rust monster touches a nonmagical metal object within 5 feet of itself that isn't being worn or carried. The touch destroys a 1-foot Cube of the object.

id-00001.name: Reflexive Antennae
id-00001.desc: Trigger: An attack roll hits the rust monster. Response: The rust monster uses Antennae.

id-00001.name: Proboscis
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge can't make Proboscis attacks, and the target takes 5 (2d4) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the stirge's turns. The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the stirge as an action.

id-00001.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
id-00001.desc: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

id-00002.name: Magic Resistance
id-00002.desc: The tarrasque has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

id-00003.name: Reflective Carapace
id-00003.desc: If the tarrasque is targeted by a Magic Missile spell or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll 1d6. On a 1–5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected and reflects the spell, turning the caster into the target.

id-00004.name: Siege Monster
id-00004.desc: The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The tarrasque makes one Bite attack and three other attacks, using Claw or Tail in any combination.

id-00002.name: Bite
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 15 ft. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) Piercing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition and can't teleport.

id-00003.name: Claw
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 15 ft. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) Slashing damage.

id-00004.name: Tail
id-00004.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 30 ft. Hit: 23 (3d8 + 10) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

id-00005.name: Thunderous Bellow (Recharge 5–6)
id-00005.desc: Constitution Sav- ing Throw: DC 27, each creature and each object that isn't being worn or carried in a 150-foot Cone. Failure: 78 (12d12) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened and Frightened conditions until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

id-00001.name: Swallow
id-00001.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 27, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the tarrasque (it can have up to six creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions and can't teleport, it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 (16d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns. If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque and has the Prone condition. If the tarrasque dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

id-00001.name: Legendary Action Uses
id-00001.desc: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the tarrasque can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The tarrasque regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

id-00002.name: Onslaught
id-00002.desc: The tarrasque moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Claw or Tail attack.

id-00003.name: World-Shaking Movement
id-00003.desc: The tarrasque moves up to its Speed. At the end of this movement, the tarrasque creates an instantaneous shock wave in a 60-foot Emanation originating from itself. Creatures in that area lose Concentration and, if Medium or smaller, have the Prone condition. The tarrasque can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

werebear.name: Werebear
werebear.speed: 30 ft., 40 ft. (bear form only), Climb 30 ft. (bear form only)

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The werebear makes two attacks, using Handaxe or Rend in any combination. It can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

id-00002.name: Bite (Bear or Hybrid Form Only)
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Werebear under the GM's control and has 10 Hit Points. Success: The target is immune to this werebear's curse for 24 hours.

id-00003.name: Handaxe (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
id-00003.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

id-00004.name: Rend (Bear or Hybrid Form Only)
id-00004.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

id-00001.name: Shape-Shift
id-00001.desc: The werebear shape-shifts into a Large bear-humanoid hybrid form or a Large bear, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The wereboar makes two attacks, using Javelin or Tusk in any combination. It can replace one attack with a Gore attack.

id-00002.name: Gore (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Wereboar under the GM's control and has 10 Hit Points. Success: The target is immune to this wereboar's curse for 24 hours.

id-00003.name: Javelin (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
id-00003.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

id-00004.name: Tusk (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
id-00004.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the wereboar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

id-00001.name: Shape-Shift
id-00001.desc: The wereboar shape-shifts into a Medium boar-humanoid hybrid or a Small boar, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The wererat makes two attacks, using Scratch or Hand Crossbow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

id-00002.name: Bite (Rat or Hybrid Form Only)
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Wererat under the GM's control and has 10 Hit Points. Success: The target is immune to this wererat's curse for 24 hours.

id-00003.name: Scratch
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

id-00004.name: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
id-00004.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

id-00001.name: Shape-Shift
id-00001.desc: The wererat shape-shifts into a Medium rat-humanoid hybrid or a Small rat, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The weretiger makes two attacks, using Scratch or Longbow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

id-00002.name: Bite (Tiger or Hybrid Form Only)
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Weretiger under the GM's control and has 10 Hit Points. Success: The target is immune to this weretiger's curse for 24 hours.

id-00003.name: Scratch
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

id-00004.name: Longbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
id-00004.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

id-00001.name: Prowl (Tiger or Hybrid Form Only)
id-00001.desc: The weretiger moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. At the end of this movement, the weretiger can take the Hide action.

id-00002.name: Shape-Shift
id-00002.desc: The weretiger shape-shifts into a Large tiger-humanoid hybrid or a Large tiger, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

id-00001.name: Pack Tactics
id-00001.desc: The werewolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the werewolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The werewolf makes two attacks, using Scratch or Longbow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

id-00002.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Werewolf under the GM's control and has 10 Hit Points. Success: The target is immune to this werewolf's curse for 24 hours.

id-00003.name: Scratch
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

id-00004.name: Longbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
id-00004.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

id-00001.name: Shape-Shift
id-00001.desc: The werewolf shape-shifts into a Large wolf-humanoid hybrid or a Medium wolf, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

id-00001.name: Pack Tactics
id-00001.desc: The wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

id-00001.name: Bite
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

id-00002.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6)
id-00002.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.gear: Light Crossbow, Shortsword, Studded Leather Armor

id-00001.name: Evasion
id-00001.desc: If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The assassin makes three attacks, using Shortsword or Light Crossbow in any combination.

id-00002.name: Shortsword
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the assassin's next turn.

id-00003.name: Light Crossbow
id-00003.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) Poison damage.

id-00001.name: Cunning Action
id-00001.desc: The assassin takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

id-00001.name: Scimitar
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.

id-00002.name: Light Crossbow
id-00002.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The bandit makes two attacks, using Scimitar and Pistol in any combination.

id-00002.name: Scimitar
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

id-00003.name: Pistol
id-00003.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage.

id-00001.name: Parry
id-00001.desc: Trigger: The bandit is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The bandit adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

id-00001.name: Bloodied Frenzy
id-00001.desc: While Bloodied, the berserker has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

id-00001.name: Greataxe
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) Slashing damage.

id-00001.name: Training
id-00001.desc: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the GM's choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

id-00001.name: Club
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage.

id-00001.name: Ritual Sickle
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 1 Necrotic damage.

id-00001.name: Pact Blade
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

id-00002.name: Spellcasting
id-00002.desc: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks): At Will: Light, Thaumaturgy 2/Day: Command 1/Day: Hold Person

id-00001.name: Spiritual Weapon (2/Day)
id-00001.desc: The cultist casts the Spiritual Weapon spell, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The druid makes two attacks, using Vine Staff or Verdant Wisp in any combination.

id-00002.name: Vine Staff
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

id-00003.name: Verdant Wisp
id-00003.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 90 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) Radiant damage.

id-00004.name: Spellcasting
id-00004.desc: The druid casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13): At Will: Druidcraft, Speak with Animals 2/Day Each: Entangle, Thunderwave 1/Day Each: Animal Messenger, Long- strider, Moonbeam

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The gladiator makes three Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shield Bash.

id-00002.name: Spear
id-00002.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

id-00003.name: Shield Bash
id-00003.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature within 5 feet that the gladiator can see. Failure: 9 (2d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

id-00001.name: Parry
id-00001.desc: Trigger: The gladiator is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The gladiator adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

id-00001.name: Spear
id-00001.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The guard makes two attacks, using Javelin or Longsword in any combination.

id-00002.name: Javelin
id-00002.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

id-00003.name: Longsword
id-00003.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Slashing damage.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The knight makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

id-00002.name: Greatsword
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage.

id-00003.name: Heavy Crossbow
id-00003.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +2, range 100/400 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage.

id-00001.name: Parry
id-00001.desc: Trigger: The knight is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The knight adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

id-00001.name: Multiattack
id-00001.desc: The mage makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

id-00002.name: Arcane Burst
id-00002.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) Force damage.

id-00003.name: Spellcasting
id-00003.desc: The mage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): At Will: Detect Magic, Light, Mage Armor (included in AC), Mage Hand, Prestidigitation 2/Day Each: Fireball (level 4 version), Invisibility 1/Day Each: Cone of Cold, Fly

id-00001.name: Misty Step (3/Day)
id-00001.desc: The mage casts Misty Step, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
